neutral_fly_path_061.scope: Ordinary living Neutral adult with locked Fly FIRST evolution only. Six balanced/Run/Power/Fly/Run+Fly/Power+Fly mature specializations; no negative Swim specialization.

neutral_fly_path_061.approximation: Exact original square head and pixel face. Two closed boxes per upper-lateral crest: fresh short downward ears; mature balanced rear/up points; Run downward squared ram hooks; Power tall upright roots with forward tips; Fly downward pointed ears; short curved Run+Fly and shorter upright Power+Fly. Six opaque closed wing rays simplify smooth tapered three-lobe fans; two-color half-length wing bands replace smooth gradients. Two slim tail boxes simplify its upward blue-tipped curl. No central stem, halo or spikeball was added.
neutral_fly_path_061.wing_policy: Three opaque closed cuboid rays per original wing bone, all root-face midpoints fixed local [0,.25,0]; distinct .30/.25/.20 thicknesses avoid coincident parallel planes. Per-vertex FIN125 at each root-X edge and UNDER124 at each distal-X edge produce a clean half-length root/distal band on all four long faces; end faces use their matching constant swatch. All original wing parents/pivots/animations unchanged; no alpha closing-edge frame.
neutral_fly_path_061.body_contact_policy: New family torso top extends .45 model pixels on every target; bottom, original59bone transforms, originalhead and attachment rig unchanged. Supports scoped .35pixel WALK head-clearance lift.
neutral_fly_path_061.marker_policy: Entire original orb, marker and expression bones/meshes byte-exact; live reference uses a smooth sphere, so no added marker geometry.
neutral_fly_path_061.provisional_rates: 960 current level-bar progress per opposing axis; independent adult maturity. No original-game timing claim.
